verification.environment: Docker Desktop on macOS 14.7.8, ARM64 Linux engine 29.6.2 / 6.12.76-linuxkit, amd64 emulation, dedicated pinned BuildKit container
verification.scope: Two sequential no-cache builds on the same builder; public registry digest and OCI source/revision labels verified. Fresh clone verified at build-context level only. Published artifact additionally smoke-tested on native x86-64 Linux, without rebuilding it there.

runtimeSmokeTests.environment: Disposable localhost-only Docker containers plus a native x86-64 GitHub Actions runner; no live Evernode lease modified
runtimeSmokeTests.http: Default site and uploaded website served byte-for-byte on port 8080; GET/HEAD health endpoint passed
runtimeSmokeTests.ssh: Public-key login as deploy (UID 1001); effective sshd configuration denies password, keyboard-interactive and direct root login
runtimeSmokeTests.sudo: sudo -n -i id returned UID 0; Node, Bun version and nvm use 24 available in deploy/root SSH shells
runtimeSmokeTests.apt: apt-get update and apt-get install -y tree succeeded over SSH; tree 2.1.1-2ubuntu3.24.04.2 installed
runtimeSmokeTests.tools: nano 7.2, jq 1.7, Python 3.12.3, rsync, Node 24.20.0, npm 11.19.0, Bun 1.4.2 and nvm 0.40.7 checked
runtimeSmokeTests.publish: Actual SSH/rsync pipeline passed dry-run, hidden/dependency exclusions, quoted paths, content update with unchanged size/mtime, default remote-file preservation, overwrite backups and optional deletion with backups
runtimeSmokeTests.nginx: Existing dotfiles/dot-directories, encoded dotfile URL, node_modules, backup/config/server-script files denied; symlink escape and directory listing denied; POST denied; security headers present on success and error responses
runtimeSmokeTests.sameVolumeRecreation: Site SHA-256 and SSH host-key SHA-256 unchanged; strict SSH host-key checking passed, private backups retained at mode 0700, sudo and bundled Node/nvm still worked
runtimeSmokeTests.runtimePackageIsolation: Interactively installed tree absent after recreation from original image, as expected

nativeRuntime.checks: Pulled exact manifest digest; Node and Bun executed JavaScript, deploy/root nvm and sudo passed; bundled tools, HTTP and same-volume website/SSH-key persistence passed

runtimeSmokeTests.localEmulationLimitation: Bun --version succeeds under this Mac's amd64 emulation, but Bun JavaScript evaluation aborts with JavaScriptCore MemoryExhaustion. The exact same published image passed JavaScript execution on native x86_64; no emulation workaround is baked into the image.
